import sys

def min_cost_to_complete_tasks(A):
    # Sort the array to easily find the minimum cost
    A.sort()
    
    # The first task is done at zero cost
    # The second task can be done with the difference between the first and second elements
    # The third task can be done with the difference between the second and third elements
    return abs(A[1] - A[0]) + abs(A[2] - A[1])

import sys

def min_cost_to_complete_tasks():
    # Read input from standard input
    A = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
    
    # Sort the array to simplify the calculation of minimum cost
    A.sort()
    
    # The minimum cost to complete all tasks is always the sum of the absolute differences between consecutive elements
    # After sorting, this is simply the difference between the maximum and minimum elements
    min_cost = abs(A[2] - A[0])
    
    # Print the result
    print(min_cost)
